questions.prompt: How did Bossy suggest finding the gift-giver?
Who had been leaving the secret gifts?
questions.evidenceText: "Shy?" Sunny asked softly. Shy nodded and tucked behind the rock.

questions.prompt: Why did the Pals make a gift for Shy?
choices: They wanted to return her kindness.
They thought Shy had lost her first gift.
They wanted to show Shy who found the gifts.
questions.answer: They wanted to return her kindness.
questions.rationale: The Pals made a gift for Shy after her gifts to them, showing that they wanted to return her kindness.
questions.evidenceText: The Pals had made one for Shy.
